title: ARWP Search & Recommendation Growth Hypotheses
goal: Turn current platform guidance and observed distribution mechanisms into explicit, testable website-growth hypotheses without treating implementation as proof of ranking causation.

hypotheses.title: Eligibility failures dominate optional optimization
hypotheses.hypothesis: Fix crawl, HTTP, indexability and snippet blockers before optional AI or agent metadata.

hypotheses.title: Original evidence beats commodity summaries
hypotheses.hypothesis: Priority pages with first-hand knowledge or original evidence are more defensible retrieval candidates than commodity summaries.

checks.expect: Page contributes experience, data, examples or analysis.

hypotheses.title: Addressable sections improve retrieval precision
hypotheses.hypothesis: Clear headings and stable anchors make important evidence easier to locate and reference.

hypotheses.title: Resolvable authorship and entity identity reduce ambiguity
hypotheses.hypothesis: Consistent entity identity and real authorship make source attribution clearer.

checks.expect: Appropriate Organization, Person or ProfilePage identity exists.

hypotheses.title: Strong visual previews improve Discover presentation opportunity
hypotheses.hypothesis: For Discover-suitable content, relevant large images and permissive previews improve visual presentation opportunity.

checks.expect: Priority content has a relevant representative image.

hypotheses.title: Preferred Sources can compound repeat-reader distribution
hypotheses.hypothesis: A Preferred Sources control can increase prominence for users who explicitly select a repeat-read site.

checks.expect: A documented Preferred Sources control is present where appropriate.

hypotheses.title: Search crawling and training permissions are separate controls
hypotheses.hypothesis: Sites targeting ChatGPT Search should avoid unintentionally blocking OAI-SearchBot while deciding GPTBot training separately.

hypotheses.title: Accurate change signals outperform synthetic freshness
hypotheses.hypothesis: Accurate freshness metadata helps discovery without fake date churn.

checks.expect: Sitemap lastmod is valid where useful.

hypotheses.title: AI visibility must be measured rather than inferred
hypotheses.hypothesis: Owner-side Google and Bing AI reports provide a better feedback loop than inferred impact.

checks.expect: Capture relevant owner-side AI visibility around material changes.

hypotheses.title: Agent readability is an interoperability experiment, not a ranking shortcut
hypotheses.hypothesis: Truthful agent metadata can reduce compatible-agent friction but must not be marketed as a ranking factor.

checks.expect: Published agent surfaces describe real capabilities.
